notes.title: Chapter 3 is here! 🌓
notes.content:
[b]🌓 Chapter 3 is now available![/b]

*Tales of Maana: Lucy* moves forward with the release of [b]Chapter 3[/b] 🌙  
Dive deeper into the narrative with new scenes, meaningful choices… and a few surprises.

[b]🆕 Recent additions and changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]🎵 New original music for the Order and main menu (by a guest composer)
[*]🧿 Added sprite for Baal
[*]🌐 Fixed several translation issues
[*]🗑️ Removed the unused progress page
[*]🎬 New credits screen
[/list]

Thank you so much for your ongoing support 💜  
Each update brings us closer to the end of this story... but we’re not there just yet.

notes.content:

notes.title: Update 0.2 — Chapter 2 is here! 🦋
notes.content:
[b]🦋 Chapter 2 is here![/b]

*Tales of Maana: Lucy* just got a big update with version 0.2!  
A new chapter, more languages, improvements… and an important note 👇

[b]⚠️ Before you play...[/b]  
This version [i]may reset your save data[/i].  
There’s a [b]high chance[/b] your progress will be lost — though in some cases, it might survive.

I’m really sorry about this 😞  
But this is the [u]first and last time[/u] this will happen.  
I’d rather do it now, early in the story, than later when everything gets more complex.

To make it up to you, [b]Chapter 1 has been improved[/b] with [b]new choices and branching paths[/b] 💜

[b]🆕 What’s new in 0.2:[/b]
[list]
[*]🌍 5 new languages: Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Russian
[*]🌹 Rose finally has a visual!
[*]📝 New official title: [i]Tales of Maana: Lucy[/i]
[*]🏆 Achievements reworked: fewer, more meaningful
[*]🛠️ UI and menus redesigned
[/list]

Thank you so much for your patience, understanding and support.  
The journey is just beginning 🌙

notes.title: Early Access is live, get ready for what's next!
notes.content:
Hey everyone 💜

It’s finally happening: [b]Tales of Maana: Lucy is now available in Early Access on Steam![/b]
I’m so happy to finally share this first playable step of the project with you. Huge thanks to all of you who’ve been patiently waiting 💫

But this is just the beginning: [b]a major update is already on the way[/b], bringing [i]Chapter 2[/i], new areas to explore, gameplay tweaks, and plenty of fixes. It’ll be out in just a few days!

And there’s another big change: the game is getting a new name.
[b]"Le Voyage de Lucy" is officially becoming "Tales of Maana: Lucy"[/b] ✨
Why the change? Well, this project has grown a lot since its early days.
Originally, the title was only meant for the French version. But the translation didn’t feel right, and it completely broke the logo design.
Steam also prefers a consistent name across all languages. Keeping one clear title helps streamline the visuals, saves time on assets, and sets the stage for what I hope will be a full saga: [i]Tales of Maana: Lucy[/i]… and maybe more stories to come 👀

Thanks again for your support, your feedback, and your kindness.
This is only the beginning 💖

notes.title: Maana Tales: Lucy, The Journey Resumes!
notes.content:
Hey everyone 💜

After a loooong silence, we finally have some good news to share: Maana Tales: Lucy is back in development!

We know it’s been a while—and it wasn’t an easy road—but today, we can finally say with a smile: the journey continues. An early access version will be available sometime soon.

The project is getting a fresh start: new code, new visuals, new mechanics. An artist is already working on brand-new character designs.

That said, some visuals during the early access period will be AI-generated. But don’t worry—everything will be fully replaced for the final version [i](and gradually along the way)[/i] with hand-drawn art.

We truly hope you’ll be there to explore the world of Maana, follow Lucy on her journey, and most of all… help us shape this game into something truly special.

Thank you for your patience, your kindness, and your passion ❤️
